up: Return a list of ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds that have been tested in assays associated with the target 'lethal malignant brain tumor-like protein 1' in Homo sapiens.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'lethal malignant brain tumor-like protein 1'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens';

OK
